name: Walkie
author: B150
description: Dictation and meeting status for Walkie — shows recording, transcribing and meeting state. Click opens Walkie; right-click dictates.

barWidget.description: Walkie status — click to open, right-click to dictate

schema.label: Walkie command
schema.description: Executable used for status and actions. Use an absolute path for an AppImage install.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Only occupy space in the bar while Walkie is recording or working.

schema.label: Show state label
schema.description: Print the state name next to the icon.

schema.label: Font family
schema.description: Overrides the bar font used for the icon glyph. Leave empty to inherit the bar's font.
